chunks: He said: 'Thus it is; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me,' and that We shall make him a sign for mankind and a mercy from Us; and it was a decree already passed.'

key_terms.أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا: A decreed matter / A thing already decided

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Jesus being called a 'sign' and 'mercy' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute ease of divine creation (Yasir al-Khalq) and positions Jesus (AS) as a cosmic sign (Ayah) and mercy, reinforcing the concept of God's direct command 'Be' (Kun). It connects to the broader narrative of miraculous births in the Quran, emphasizing that such events are not anomalies but fulfilled divine decrees (Amran Maqdhiyan) intended to guide humanity.
